text:
emma: Heads-up — we have three docs PRs that need a merge window before the release cutoff. Two of them touch versioned guides and one updates the SDK snippet that ties into the feature-flag rollout. Can reviewers ACK?
raj: Which PRs exactly? paste links pls.
emma: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4135 (versioning: api changes), https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4140 (sdk snippet + example), https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4142 (migration guide fix).
marco: I can take #4135 — will check for breaking changes vs 2.1 docs.
olivia: I'll review #4140 this afternoon. Quick note: CI preview is flaky with the new snippet import path.
ci-bot: [preview] build queued for PR #4140 — see https://preview.redwood.dev/preview/4140
emma: thanks. For the release plan, feature flag rollout will start at 2026-04-03 09:00 UTC. We need the docs live (or behind versioned toggle) by then.
raj: Is there a docs-side feature flag control? We usually gate the tutorial with a short notice and a banner.
emma: For the SDK snippet change, we want the public page to show old snippet until rollout completes. So we should merge into release branch and set frontmatter: "hidden: true" then flip after rollout.
marco: For #4135, I spotted a mismatch in endpoint names. Small risk but affects examples. I'll push a tiny fix and request a re-run.
olivia: CI preview for #4140 is failing with this error: `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'redwood_sdk.v2'`. The snippet uses `redwood_sdk.v2` — the preview container has v1 only.
emma: Good catch. Options: (a) change snippet to conditional comment showing both, (b) update preview image to include v2 package, (c) merge behind a note. Thoughts?
raj: (b) would be best for accuracy but slower. How long to rebuild preview image?
olivia: ~45 mins for a new image build + cache warm. Not ideal for a quick cutoff.
marco: I can do (a) — update snippet to include a short `# v1/v2 example` comment and both import variants. That keeps preview green and docs accurate.
emma: OK do (a) and add a followup issue to revert to single snippet post-rollout. Also add frontmatter `hidden: true` on the SDK page and link to preview in the PR description.
marco: Will push patch in 20m.
ci-bot: [preview] rebuild triggered for PR #4140 by marco — https://preview.redwood.dev/preview/4140/refresh
raj: When do we want to actually merge to the release branch? We need to avoid the feature-flag cutoff at 2026-04-02 23:59 UTC.
emma: Aim to have merges done by 2026-04-02 18:00 UTC to give the release train time to validate. If any CI preview shows problems after that, we hold and file rollback plan.
olivia: I'll prioritize #4140 review first. If I finish early, will review #4142.
marco: Patch pushed to #4140, added dual-snippet + comment, frontmatter hidden flag, and a line in PR body: `Preview: https://preview.redwood.dev/preview/4140`
olivia: Reviewing now... small nits, but LGTM after I fix spacing.
marco: PTAL for nits resolved.
olivia: LGTM :thumbsup:
emma: Great. Once #4140 and #4135 are green, let's coordinate the merge window: I'll do the final merge to release branch at 2026-04-02 16:30 UTC unless anyone objects.
raj: Works for me.
marco: Fine by me.
ci-bot: [status] PR #4135: checks passed. PR #4140: preview ready. PR #4142: awaiting review.
emma: For #4142 (migration guide), tagging @doc-maintainers for a quick verification that there are no backward-incompatibility notes missing.
raj: I'll skim #4142 tonight and leave comments if anything major.
emma: If all clear, merge cadence: #4135 and #4140 merged to release branch at 16:30 UTC; #4142 merged after final sign-off but ideally before cutoff. If #4142 isn't ready, we hold it for post-release patch.
marco: Sounds good. I'll be on standby during the merge window in case we need quick rollback.
olivia: I'll watch preview links and confirm post-merge render.
emma: Thanks all. I'll update the release checklist and ping here 1 hour before merge. :rocket:
